annotations.title: Quote an x402 paid API call via Rooms

description: Use when you want a paid x402 API's price before paying. Rooms resells x402 paid APIs from its directory. Give a listing slug (from search_agents with protocol x402) and the request (optional path, method, query, body); returns the live all-in price (seller price plus the Rooms margin) and the exact POST to make. The call itself is paid with x402 (USDC on Base); you get the seller's answer plus a signed Rooms receipt, and you're never charged when the seller fails. It never pays or calls the seller.

method.description: HTTP method for the seller (default: the listed one)

path.description: One of the listing's paid paths (default: its main one)
